description: Water New Zealand produced the National Performance Review, a publication and dashboard of performance information for the reticulated drinking water, wastewater and stormwater service providers that took part, with reports for previous years. Coverage is New Zealand's participating providers, most recently for 2021/22. The publication and dashboard are free to read online, and the page also lists the Water Services Managers' Group and the Water Utilities Association. Caveats: only the providers that took part are included, and no edition after 2021/22 is shown. Simulation uses: service performance baselines for drinking water, wastewater and stormwater networks. Related records: Australia's urban water performance report (data-bom-national-performance-report-urban-water).
